title: Restriction along a localization preserves K-flat module complexes
statement: Let R and Rp be commutative rings, with an R-algebra structure on Rp and Rp a localization at a submonoid S of R. For any unbounded cochain complex P of Rp-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] that is K-flat [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], its degreewise restriction of scalars along R to Rp is K-flat as an R-complex. No boundedness or nonzero hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 06Y6 (derived change of rings), with algebra.tex Tag 00CS (exact localization). Official Stacks pages read online; this clone has no literature sources.

proof.text: Use IsLocalization.flat and ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat to make extension of scalars R to Rp exact. Thus its degreewise functor E preserves every quasi-isomorphism. This is the flat-localization instance of Tag 00CS.

For a quasi-isomorphism a:F to G of R-complexes, K-flatness of P makes P tensor_Rp E(a) a quasi-isomorphism. HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorFlipIso and its naturality identify this arrow with the flipped mixed total tensor B(a,P), since mixedTensor is tensor after extension of scalars. Restriction is exact, so restriction of B(a,P) remains a quasi-isomorphism.

Apply the natural mixed-tensor restriction isomorphism: U(B(F,P)) is isomorphic to F tensor_R U(P). Its naturality gives an isomorphism of arrows from U(B(a,P)) to a tensor_R U(P). Quasi-isomorphisms are invariant under arrow isomorphism. Thus tensorRight U(P) preserves quasi-isomorphisms. Braiding naturality gives the same for tensorLeft U(P). Their conjunction is the K-flat predicate.

lean.statement:
theorem kFlat_restrictScalars_of_isLocalization
    {R Rp : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing Rp] [Algebra R Rp]
    (S : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization S Rp]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} Rp) ℤ)
    (hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} Rp) (.up ℤ)).kFlat P) :
    (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).kFlat
      (((restrictScalars (algebraMap R Rp)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
